name: Lionel Messi
clues: I am the only men's player to win eight Ballon d'Or awards.
I spent 21 glorious years in Catalonia before moving to Paris and then South Florida.
I captained my nation to Copa América glory in 2021 and the FIFA World Cup title in 2022.
Famous for wearing the #10 jersey, incredible low center of gravity, and iconic left-footed curlers.

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
trophies: 34 Career Trophies · 5 Champions Leagues · 5 Ballon d'Or
clues: I am the men's all-time record goalscorer in international football history.
I conquered England, Spain, and Italy by winning domestic league titles and cups in all three.
I scored 450 goals in 438 matches for Real Madrid and won 5 Champions League crowns.
Famous worldwide by my initials and shirt number: CR7.

name: Luka Modrić
trophies: 27 Trophies with Real Madrid · 2018 Ballon d'Or
clues: I won the 2018 Ballon d'Or after orchestrating an unforgettable run to the World Cup Final in Moscow.
I spent four influential seasons at White Hart Lane in London before moving to the Spanish capital in 2012.
I have won a record 6 UEFA Champions League trophies with Real Madrid.
Famous for outside-of-the-boot 'trivela' passes and controlling midfield tempos.

name: Marta
trophies: 6x FIFA World Player of the Year · All-Time World Cup Scorer
clues: I have been crowned FIFA World Player of the Year a record six times.
I hold the all-time record for most goals scored in FIFA World Cup tournaments (17 goals).
I led Brazil to multiple Olympic medals and became a global icon known simply by my first name.
Nicknamed 'Pelé in skirts' by Pelé himself.

name: Zinedine Zidane
trophies: World Cup 1998 · Euro 2000 · 3x UCL as Manager
clues: I scored two headers in the 1998 World Cup Final to bring my country its first title.
I struck one of the greatest volleys in Champions League history in Glasgow in 2002.
As a manager, I led Real Madrid to three consecutive UEFA Champions League titles between 2016 and 2018.
Renowned for the signature 360-degree roulette turn and graceful ball mastery.

name: Erling Haaland
trophies: European Treble 2023 · 2x Premier League Golden Boot
clues: I broke the Premier League single-season scoring record in my debut season with 36 goals.
Before moving to England, I scored 86 goals in 89 games for Borussia Dortmund.
I scored 9 goals in a single match against Honduras at the 2019 FIFA U-20 World Cup.
A towering Scandinavian striker celebrated for meditating goal celebrations.

name: Kylian Mbappé
hints: Scored a historic World Cup final hat-trick in Lusail in 2022.
Became Paris Saint-Germain's all-time top goalscorer with 256 goals.
Won the 2018 World Cup as a teenager, scoring in the final against Croatia.

name: Ronaldinho
hints: Received a famous standing ovation from Real Madrid fans at the Santiago Bernabéu in 2005.
Won the 2005 Ballon d'Or and the 2002 FIFA World Cup.
Famous for unmatched flair, the elastico dribble, and the 'Joga Bonito' smile.

name: Andrés Iniesta
hints: Scored the dramatic 116th-minute World Cup-winning goal in Johannesburg in 2010.
Won 4 UEFA Champions League titles and 9 La Liga trophies as Barcelona's midfield maestro.
Named Man of the Match in the 2010 World Cup Final and Euro 2012 Final.

name: Karim Benzema
hints: Won the 2022 Ballon d'Or after an unforgettable 15-goal Champions League campaign.
Won 5 UEFA Champions League titles during 14 historic seasons at Real Madrid.
Real Madrid's second all-time highest goalscorer behind Cristiano Ronaldo with 354 goals.

name: Manuel Neuer
hints: Redefined modern goalkeeping as the iconic 'sweeper-keeper' at the 2014 World Cup.
Captained Germany and Bayern Munich to continental trebles and World Cup glory.
Kept over 220 clean sheets in the Bundesliga, an all-time record.

name: Neymar Jr
hints: Brazil's all-time leading goalscorer, surpassing Pelé's official tally.
Part of Barcelona's immortal 'MSN' trident that swept the 2015 continental treble.
Commands the highest transfer fee in football history (€222 million).
